title: Long-term Safety Study of the GORE® HELEX® Septal Occluder
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the long-term safety and efficacy of the GORE® HELEX® Septal Occluder in the treatment of ostium secundum atrial septal defects (ASDs).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ASD less than or equal to 18 mm.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Conditions that would confound treatment of ASD or complicate distinguishing onset of adverse events.
* Unable to accommodate device delivery catheter.
